title: Ali and His Friend
text:
Ali has a small blue bag. He goes to school every day. In the bag, he has a book, a pen and a red pencil. After school, he goes to the park with his friend Ayşe. They play ball and talk about their day.

Ayşe has a green bicycle. It is new and fast. Ali likes the bicycle very much. Today they ride bicycles near the lake. The sun is warm and the sky is blue.

questions.text: What kind of friends are Ali and Ayşe?
options: They are friends who never meet
They are good friends who share fun activities
They are enemies who do not talk
They are teachers at the same school

questions.text: What can we say about Ali?
options: He likes playing with his friend

vocabulary.definition: a person you like and spend time with
a vehicle with two wheels that you ride with your feet on pedals
a place where children go to learn

paragraph_translations: Ali'nin küçük mavi bir çantası var. Her gün okula gider. Çantada bir kitap, bir kalem ve kırmızı bir kurşun kalem var. Okuldan sonra arkadaşı Ayşe ile parka gider. Top oynarlar ve günleri hakkında konuşurlar.
Ayşe'nin yeşil bir bisikleti var. Yeni ve hızlı. Ali bisikleti çok sever. Bugün gölün yanında bisiklet sürerler. Güneş sıcak ve gökyüzü mavi.
